options.name: Standard API & Migration Baseline
options.summary: Provide the documented REST API for integration and record migration features, while excluding unsupported timelines, availability commitments, FERPA attribute release, and instruction handling.
assumptions: The buyer accepts standard integration and migration tools without custom availability or timeline guarantees.

scores.reason: Meets core electronic signing and record-keeping through documented APIs, but lacks specific technical breadth for FERPA controls.
Does not address service levels and incident response commitments.
Meets migration and integration needs using built-in historic record migration and REST APIs.

options.name: Alternative Partner-Assisted Integration
options.summary: Use built-in APIs and migration features alongside a partner approach for managing timelines and custom integrations, excluding unsupported availability and FERPA controls.
assumptions: A third-party implementation partner can bridge timeline and attribute release gaps.

scores.reason: Meets technical approach requirements via configured APIs and alternative handling for student PII.
Does not provide the required service level and support assurances directly.
Exceeds baseline integration by incorporating partner-assisted timeline and migration coordination.
